response.rationale: The item is apparel (not electronics), not final sale, not defective, no goodwill grant, and no fraud hold. At 45 days since delivery, it exceeds the standard 30-day window, so RET-008 (ineligible) applies. No higher-priority rule (RET-012, RET-020, RET-050, RET-051) has a true condition on these facts.
